Allergy.label: Low
Allergy.advice: Usually manageable with OTC antihistamines. See a doctor if symptoms persist beyond 1 week or are severe.

Asthma.label: High
Asthma.advice: Use rescue inhaler if available. Seek medical attention promptly. Go to ER if breathing is severely restricted.

Bronchitis.label: Medium
Bronchitis.advice: Rest and stay hydrated. See a doctor within 2-3 days, especially with high fever or blood in cough.

Common Cold.label: Low
Common Cold.advice: Rest, fluids, and OTC cold remedies. Should resolve in 7-10 days. See a doctor if symptoms worsen.

Food Poisoning.label: Medium
Food Poisoning.advice: Stay hydrated. Seek immediate care if severely dehydrated, blood in stool, or symptoms persist beyond 48 hours.

Gastritis.label: Medium
Gastritis.advice: Avoid spicy/acidic foods and NSAIDs. See a doctor if severe or persistent. Antacids may help short-term.

Influenza.label: Medium
Influenza.advice: Rest and fluids. See a doctor if in a high-risk group or symptoms worsen after initial improvement.

Migraine.label: Medium
Migraine.advice: Rest in a dark, quiet room. OTC pain relievers may help. See a doctor for recurring or severe migraines.

Sinusitis.label: Low
Sinusitis.advice: Nasal irrigation and decongestants can help. See a doctor if symptoms last beyond 10 days or worsen.

Ulcer.label: High
Ulcer.advice: See a doctor soon. Avoid NSAIDs and acidic foods. Go to ER immediately if you see black/tarry stools or vomit blood.

data_note: Original Kaggle CSV had randomly assigned symptoms (no medical signal). Model trained on medically-grounded synthetic dataset with clinical symptom prevalence probabilities per disease.
